background.err.badFileType: Files of type “{ext}” can't be saved.
background.err.network: Network problem. Check your internet connection and try again.
background.err.openFailed: Couldn't open the file. It may have been moved or deleted.
background.err.pickFailed: The folder picker couldn't be opened. Type or paste the folder path instead.
background.err.tooManyJobs: This tab already has {max} downloads waiting or running. Wait until some of them have finished, then try again.
background.err.updateBusy: yt-dlp can't be updated while downloads are running or another update is in progress. Try again when they have finished.
background.err.updateFailed: yt-dlp couldn't be updated. Try again later, or run install.bat again to repair the companion app.
background.err.updateNetwork: The new version of yt-dlp couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
background.err.updateTimeout: The yt-dlp update took too long and was stopped. Check your internet connection and try again.
background.err.updateUnsupported: This copy of yt-dlp can't update itself. Update it the same way you installed it.
background.host.badAnswer: The companion app sent an unexpected answer. Run install.bat again to update it.
background.host.forbidden: The companion app is registered for a different extension. Run install.bat again.
background.host.policy: Your administrator has blocked companion apps (native messaging) in this browser. Ask them to allow the companion app.
background.host.startFailed: The companion app couldn't be started. Run install.bat again to repair it — it sets up Deno, yt-dlp and FFmpeg.
background.host.timeout: The companion app didn't answer in time. Try again, or run install.bat again if this keeps happening.
background.menu.noVideo: No YouTube video was found in this link.
background.reloadTab.text: This tab was opened before the extension was installed or updated. Reload it to use keyboard shortcuts.
background.reloadTab.title: Reload the YouTube tab
job.err.access_denied: Windows blocked access (Controlled folder access, antivirus or folder permissions). Allow the companion app in Windows Security, or choose another download folder.
job.err.age: This video is age-restricted. Sign in to YouTube in this browser and turn on “Use my YouTube login” in Settings → Downloads.
job.err.bad_folder: The download folder in Settings → Downloads can't be used (the path is too long, or Windows doesn't allow one of its names). Choose another folder.
job.err.bad_task: The companion app rejected this download request.
job.err.bot: YouTube asked to confirm that you're not a bot. Sign in to YouTube in this browser and turn on “Use my YouTube login” in Settings → Downloads, or try again later.
job.err.busy: The companion app is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
job.err.disk: There isn't enough free space for the download.
job.err.drm: This video is protected (DRM) and can't be downloaded.
job.err.ffmpeg: FFmpeg is missing or failed. Run install.bat again to repair the companion app.
job.err.forbidden: YouTube refused the download (HTTP 403). Update yt-dlp in the settings (Companion app) and try again.
job.err.format: The selected quality isn't available for this video. Choose another one.
job.err.host_error: The companion app couldn't be started. Run install.bat again to repair it.
job.err.host_exit: The companion app stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
job.err.host_forbidden: The companion app isn't allowed to work with this extension. Run install.bat again.
job.err.host_missing: The companion app isn't installed. Open the settings (Companion app) to install it.
job.err.host_outdated: The companion app is outdated. Run install.bat again to update it.
job.err.host_policy: Your administrator has blocked companion apps in this browser, so the companion app can't download. Ask them to allow it.
job.err.live: Live streams can't be downloaded while they are live. Try again after the stream ends.
job.err.locked: Another program (antivirus or a cloud sync app) was using the file. Try again, or exclude the download folder from scanning or syncing.
job.err.members: This video is for channel members only. Sign in to YouTube in this browser and turn on “Use my YouTube login” in Settings → Downloads.
job.err.network: Network problem. Check your internet connection and try again.
job.err.no_subtitles: These subtitles aren't available for this video. Choose another language or track, or try again later.
job.err.rate_limited: YouTube is limiting requests right now (HTTP 429). Wait a few minutes and try again.
job.err.timeout: The companion app didn't answer in time. Try again.
job.err.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp is missing. Run install.bat again to repair the companion app.
job.interrupted: Interrupted because the browser or the extension was closed. Click Retry to start again.
